SEST GALLERY

A photo gallery of the units in the SEST collection: 516 real photographs,
88 flags and 12 loading-screen backgrounds, indexed against all 190 Workshop
mods and the SEST Integration Pack.

HOW TO OPEN IT
1. In Sea Power's Mod Manager, select SEST Integration Pack and press
   Open Folder (or browse to the pack's Workshop folder).
2. Open the Gallery folder.
3. Double-click gallery.html. It opens in your web browser and works offline.

It is a separate page, not part of the game. It does not change anything in
Sea Power, and the game has no place to show these photos.

WHAT IS IN IT
gallery.html          Photos, unit index, collection and systems.
visual_overhaul.html  Flags and loading-screen backgrounds.
PHOTO_CREDITS.txt     Creator, licence, source and changes for every photo.
VISUAL_CREDITS.txt    The same for the flags and backgrounds.
data/                 The indexes as spreadsheets (CSV).

ABOUT THE PHOTOS
Only sourced real photographs are used. No AI imagery. Each photo keeps its
own licence (public domain, CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA or OGL); the credits files
give the creator, licence and source page for each one, and they must stay
with the photos if you pass them on.

Not every unit has an exact photo. Many use a photo of the same family, an
earlier variant or a related system, and each one says which. Units with no
photo yet are listed as photo gaps.
